column3: śriyaḥ kurūṇām adhipasya pālanīṁ prajāsu vṛttiṁ yam sa varṇiliṅgī viditaḥ samāyayau yudhiṣṭhiraṁ dvaitavane |
kṛtapraṇāmasya mahīṁ mahībhuje jitāṁ sapatnena na vivyathe tasya mano na hi priyaṁ pravaktum icchanti |
dviṣāṁ vighātāya vidhātum icchato rahasy anujñām sa sauṣṭhavaudāryaviśeṣaśālinīṁ viniścitārthām iti vācam |
kriyāsu yuktair nṛpa cāracakṣuṣo na vañcanīyāḥ prabhavo ato .rhasi kṣantum asādhu sādhu vā hitaṁ manohāri ca |
sa kiṁsakhā sādhu na śāsti yo .dhipaṁ hitān na yaḥ sadānukūleṣu hi kurvate ratiṁ nṛpeṣv amātyeṣu ca |
nisargadurbodham abodhaviklavāḥ kva bhūpatīnāṁ tavānubhāvo .yam abodhi yan mayā nigūḍhatattvaṁ |
viśaṅkamāno bhavataḥ parābhavaṁ nṛpāsanastho .pi durodaracchadmajitāṁ samīhate nayena jetuṁ jagatīṁ |
tathāpi jihmaḥ sa bhavajjigīṣayā tanoti śubhraṁ samunnayan bhūtim anāryasaṁgamād varaṁ virodho .pi |
kṛtāriṣaḍvargajayena mānavīm agamyarūpāṁ padavīṁ vibhajya naktaṁdinam astatandriṇā vitanyate tena nayena |
sakhīn iva prītiyujo .nujīvinaḥ samānamānān suhṛdaś ca sa saṁtataṁ darśayate gatasmayaḥ kṛtādhipatyām iva |
asaktam ārādhayato yathāyathaṁ vibhajya bhaktyā guṇānurāgād iva sakhyam īyivān na bādhate .sya trigaṇaḥ |
niratyayaṁ sāma na dānavarjitaṁ na bhūri dānaṁ pravartate tasya viśeṣaśālinī guṇānurodhena vinā na |
vasūni vāñchan na vaśī na manyunā svadharma ity eva gurūpadiṣṭena ripau sute .pi vā nihanti daṇḍena sa |
vidhāya rakṣān paritaḥ paretarān aśaṅkitākāram upaiti kriyāpavargeṣv anujīvisātkṛtāḥ kṛtajñatām asya vadanti |
anārataṁ tena padeṣu lambhitā vibhajya samyag phalanty upāyāḥ paribṛṁhitāyatīr upetya saṁgharṣam |
anekarājanyarathāśvasaṁkulaṁ tadīyam nayaty ayugmacchadagandhir ārdratāṁ bhṛśaṁ |
sukhena labhyā dadhataḥ kṛṣīvalair akṛṣṭapacyā iva vitanvati kṣemam adevamātṛkāś cirāya tasmin kuravaś |
mahaujaso mānadhanā dhanārcitā dhanurbhṛtaḥ saṁyati na saṁhatās tasya na bhedavṛttayaḥ priyāṇi vāñchanty |
udārakīrter udayaṁ dayāvataḥ praśāntabādhaṁ diśato svayaṁ pradugdhe .sya guṇair upasnutā vasūpamānasya |
mahībhujāṁ saccaritaiś caraiḥ kriyāḥ sa veda niḥśeṣam mahodayais tasya hitānubandhibhiḥ pratīyate dhātur |
na tena sajyaṁ kvacid udyataṁ dhanur na vā kṛtaṁ guṇānurāgeṇa śirobhir uhyate narādhipair mālyam ivāsya |
sa yauvarājye navayauvanoddhataṁ nidhāya duḥśāsanam makheṣv akhinno .numataḥ purodhasā dhinoti havyena |
pralīnabhūpālam api sthirāyati praśāsad āvāridhi sa cintayaty eva bhiyas tvad eṣyatīr aho durantā |
kathāprasaṅgena janair udāhṛtād tavābhidhānād vyathate natānanaḥ sa duḥsahān |
tad āśu kartuṁ tvayi jihmam udyate vidhīyatāṁ tatra parapraṇītāni vacāṁsi cinvatāṁ pravṛttisārāḥ khalu |
itīrayitvā giram āttasatkriye gate .tha patyau praviśya kṛṣṇā sadanaṁ mahībhujā tad ācacakṣe |
niśamya siddhiṁ dviṣatām apākṛtīs tatas tatastyā nṛpasya manyuvyavasāyadīpinīr udājahāra drupadātmajā |
bhavādṛśeṣu pramadājanoditaṁ bhavaty adhikṣepa tathāpi vaktuṁ vyavasāyayanti māṁ nirastanārīsamayā |
akhaṇḍam ākhaṇḍalatulyadhāmabhiś ciraṁ dhṛtā tvayā svahastena mahī madacyutā mataṅgajena srag |
vrajanti te mūḍhadhiyaḥ parābhavaṁ bhavanti māyāviṣu praviśya hi ghnanti śaṭhās tathāvidhān asaṁvṛtāṅgān niśitā |
guṇānuraktām anuraktasādhanaḥ kulābhimānī kulajāṁ parais tvadanyaḥ ka ivāpahārayen manoramām |
bhavantam etarhi manasvigarhite vivartamānaṁ naradeva kathaṁ na manyur jvalayaty udīritaḥ śamītaruṁ śuṣkam |
avandhyakopasya nihantur āpadāṁ bhavanti vaśyāḥ amarṣaśūnyena janasya jantunā na jātahārdena na |
paribhramaṁl lohitacandanocitaḥ padātir antargiri mahārathaḥ satyadhanasya mānasaṁ dunoti te kaccid ayaṁ |
vijitya yaḥ prājyam ayacchad uttarān kurūn akupyaṁ vasu sa valkavāsāṁsi tavādhunāharan karoti manyuṁ na |
vanāntaśayyākaṭhinīkṛtākṛtī kacācitau viṣvag ivāgajau kathaṁ tvam etau dhṛtisaṁyamau yamau vilokayann |
imām ahaṁ veda na tāvakīṁ dhiyaṁ vicitrarūpāḥ khalu vicintayantyā bhavadāpadaṁ parāṁ rujanti cetaḥ |
purādhirūḍhaḥ śayanaṁ mahādhanaṁ vibodhyase yaḥ adabhradarbhām adhiśayya sa sthalīṁ jahāsi nidrām |
puropanītaṁ nṛpa rāmaṇīyakaṁ dvijātiśeṣeṇa yad etad tad adya te vanyaphalāśinaḥ paraṁ paraiti kārśyaṁ yaśasā |
anārataṁ yau maṇipīṭhaśāyināv arañjayad rājaśiraḥsrajāṁ niṣīdatas tau caraṇau vaneṣu te mṛgadvijālūnaśikheṣu |
dviṣannimittā yad iyaṁ daśā tataḥ samūlam unmūlayatīva parair aparyāsitavīryasampadāṁ parābhavo .py utsava eva |
vihāya śāntiṁ nṛpa dhāma tat punaḥ prasīda saṁdhehi vrajanti śatrūn avadhūya niḥspṛhāḥ śamena siddhiṁ |
puraḥsarā dhāmavatāṁ yaśodhanāḥ suduḥsahaṁ prāpya bhavādṛśāś ced adhikurvate parān nirāśrayā hanta hatā |
atha kṣamām eva nirastasādhanaś cirāya paryeṣi sukhasya vihāya lakṣmīpatilakṣma kārmukaṁ jaṭādharaḥ sañ |
na samayaparirakṣaṇaṁ kṣamaṁ te nikṛtipareṣu pareṣu ariṣu hi vijayārthinaḥ kṣitīśā vidadhati sopadhi |
vidhisamayaniyogād dīptisaṁhārajihmaṁ śithilabalam riputimiram udasyodīyamānaṁ dinādau dinakṛtam iva |
vihitāṁ priyayā manaḥpriyām atha niścitya giraṁ upapattimad ūrjitāśrayaṁ nṛpam ūce vacanaṁ vṛkodaraḥ |
pariṇāmasukhe garīyasi vyathake .smin vacasi kṣataujasām ativīryavatīva bheṣaje bahur alpīyasi dṛśyate guṇaḥ ||
iyam iṣṭaguṇāya rocatāṁ rucirārthā bhavate .pi bhāratī |
nanu vaktṛviśeṣaniḥspṛhā guṇagṛhyā vacane vipaścitaḥ ||
catasṛṣv api te vivekinī nṛpa vidyāsu nirūḍhim āgatā |
katham etya matir viparyayaṁ kariṇī paṅkam ivāvasīdati ||
vidhuraṁ kim ataḥ paraṁ parair avagītāṁ gamite daśām avasīdati yat surair api tvayi saṁbhāvitavṛtti pauruṣam ||
dviṣatām udayaḥ sumedhasā gurur asvantataraḥ na mahān api bhūtim icchatā phalasampatpravaṇaḥ |
acireṇa parasya bhūyasīṁ viparītāṁ vigaṇayya cātmanaḥ |
kṣayayuktim upekṣate kṛtī kurute tatpratikāram anyathā ||
kṣayayuktam api svabhāvajaṁ dadhataṁ dhāma śivaṁ praṇamanty anapāyam utthitaṁ pratipaccandram iva prajā |
prabhavaḥ khalu kośadaṇḍayoḥ kṛtapañcāṅgavinirṇayo sa vidheyapadeṣu dakṣatāṁ niyatiṁ loka ivānurudhyate ||
abhimānavato manasvinaḥ priyam uccaiḥ padam vinipātanivartanakṣamaṁ matam ālambanam |
vipado .bhibhavanty avikramaṁ rahayaty āpadupetam niyatā laghutā nirāyater agarīyān na padaṁ nṛpaśriyaḥ ||
tad alaṁ pratipakṣam unnater avalambya nivasanti parākramāśrayā na viṣādena samaṁ |
dviṣatā vihitaṁ tvayāthavā yadi labdhā punar ātmanaḥ jananātha tavānujanmanāṁ kṛtam āviṣkṛtapauruṣair |
madasiktamukhair mṛgādhipaḥ karibhir vartayati svayaṁ laghayan khalu tejasā jagan na mahān icchati bhūtim |
abhimānadhanasya gatvarair asubhiḥ sthāsnu yaśaś acirāṁśuvilāsacañcalā nanu lakṣmīḥ phalam ānuṣaṅgikam |
jvalitaṁ na hiraṇyaretasaṁ cayam āskandati bhasmanāṁ abhibhūtibhayād asūn ataḥ sukham ujhanti na dhāma |
kim avekṣya phalaṁ payodharān dhvanataḥ prārthayate prakṛtiḥ khalu sā mahīyasaḥ sahate nānyasamunnatiṁ yayā |
kuru tanmatim eva vikrame nṛpa nirdhūya tamaḥ dhruvam etad avehi vidviṣāṁ tvadanutsāhahatā vipattayaḥ |
dviradān iva digvibhāvitāṁś caturas toyanidhīn ivāyataḥ |
prasaheta raṇe tavānujān dviṣatāṁ kaḥ śatamanyutejasaḥ ||
jvalatas tava jātavedasaḥ satataṁ vairikṛtasya cetasi |
vidadhātu śamaṁ śivetarā ripunārīnayanāmbusantatiḥ ||
apavarjitaviplave śucau hṛdayagrāhiṇi maṅgalāspade |
vimalā tava vistare girāṁ matir ādarśa ivābhidṛśyate ||
sphuṭatā na padair apākṛtā na ca na svīkṛtam racitā pṛthagarthatā girāṁ na ca sāmarthyam apohitaṁ |
sahasā vidadhīta na kriyām avivekaḥ param āpadāṁ vṛṇate hi vimṛśyakāriṇaṁ guṇalubdhāḥ svayam eva |
abhivarṣati yo .nupālayan vidhibījāni vivekavāriṇā |
sa sadā phalaśālinīṁ kriyāṁ śaradaṁ loka ivādhitiṣṭhati ||
śuci bhūṣayati śrutaṁ vapuḥ praśamas tasya bhavaty praśamābharaṇaṁ parākramaḥ sa |
spṛhaṇīyaguṇair mahātmabhiś carite vartmani yacchatāṁ vidhihetur ahetur āgasāṁ vinipāto .pi samaḥ samunnateḥ ||
śivam aupayikaṁ garīyasīṁ phalaniṣpattim adūṣitāyatim |
vigaṇayya nayanti pauruṣaṁ vijitakrodharayā jigīṣavaḥ ||
apaneyam udetum icchatā timiraṁ roṣamayaṁ dhiyā puraḥ avibhidya niśākṛtaṁ tamaḥ prabhayā nāṁśumatāpy |
balavān api kopajanmanas tamaso nābhibhavaṁ ruṇaddhi kṣayapakṣa ivaindavīḥ kalāḥ sakalā hanti sa śaktisampadaḥ |
samavṛttir upaiti mārdavaṁ samaye yaś ca tanoti tigmatām adhitiṣṭhati lokam ojasā sa vivasvān iva medinīpatiḥ ||
kva cirāya parigrahaḥ śriyāṁ kva ca duṣṭendriyavājivaśyatā śaradabhracalāś calendriyair asurakṣā hi bahucchalāḥ śriyaḥ |
kim asāmayikaṁ vitanvatā manasaḥ kṣobham kriyate patir uccakair apāṁ bhavatā dhīratayādharīkṛtaḥ ||
śrutam apy adhigamya ye ripūn vinayante sma na janayanty acirāya sampadām ayaśas te khalu cāpalāśrayam |
upakārakam āyater bhṛśaṁ prasavaḥ karmaphalasya anapāyi nibarhaṇaṁ dviṣāṁ na titikṣāsamam asti |
suhṛdaḥ sahajās tathetare matam eṣāṁ na vilaṅghayanti ye vinayād iva yāpayanti te dhṛtarāṣṭrātmajam ātmasiddhaye |
abhiyoga imān mahībhujo bhavatā tasya tataḥ kṛtāvadheḥ |
pravighāṭayitā samutpatan haridaśvaḥ kamalākarān iva ||
upajāpasahān vilaṅghayan sa vidhātā nṛpatīn madoddhataḥ sahate na jano .py adhaḥkriyāṁ kimu lokādhikadhāma |
madamānasamuddhataṁ nṛpaṁ na viyuṅkte niyamena atimūḍha udasyate nayān nayahīnād aparajyate janaḥ ||
aparāgasamīraṇeritaḥ kramaśīrṇākulamūlasantatiḥ |
sukaras taruvat sahiṣṇunā ripur unmūlayituṁ mahān api ||
aṇur apy upahanti vigrahaḥ prabhum akhilaṁ hi hinasti bhūdharaṁ taruśākhāntanigharṣajo |
matimān vinayapramāthinaḥ samupekṣeta samunnatiṁ sujayaḥ khalu tādṛg antare vipadantā hy avinītasampadaḥ |
laghuvṛttitayā bhidāṁ gataṁ bahir antaś ca nṛpasya abhibhūya haraty anantaraḥ śithilaṁ kūlam ivāpagārayaḥ ||
madhurair avaśāni lambhayann api tiryañci śamaṁ paritaḥ paṭu bibhrad enasāṁ dahanaṁ dhāma |
athoccakair āsanataḥ parārdhyād udyan sa rarāja kīrṇākapiśāṁśujālaḥ śṛṅgāt sumeror iva tigmaraśmiḥ |
avahitahṛdayo vidhāya sa arhām ṛṣivad ṛṣipravare tadanumatam alaṁcakāra paścāt praśama iva śrutam |
vyaktoditasmitamayūkhavibhāsitoṣṭhas tiṣṭhan muner tanvantam iddham abhito gurum aṁśujālaṁ lakṣmīm |
tataḥ śaraccandrakarābhirāmair utsarpibhiḥ prāṁśum bibhrāṇam ānīlarucaṁ piśaṅgīr jaṭās taḍitvantam |
prasādalakṣmīṁ dadhataṁ samagrāṁ vapuḥprakarṣeṇa prasahya cetaḥsu samāsajantam asaṁstutānām api bhāvam |
anuddhatākāratayā viviktāṁ tanvantam antaḥkaraṇasya mādhuryavisrambhaviśeṣabhājā kṛtopasambhāṣam |
dharmātmajo dharmanibandhinīnāṁ prasūtim hetuṁ tadabhyāgamane parīpsuḥ sukhopaviṣṭaṁ munim |
anāptapuṇyopacarair durāpā phalasya nirdhūtarajāḥ savitrī tulyā bhavaddarśanasampad eṣā vṛṣṭer divo |
adya kriyāḥ kāmadughāḥ kratūnāṁ satyāśiṣaḥ samprati ā saṁsṛter asmi jagatsu jātas tvayyāgate yad |
śriyaṁ vikarṣaty apahanty aghāni śreyaḥ parisnauti tanoti saṁdarśanaṁ lokaguror amogham amoghaṁ tavātmayoner |
ścyotanmayūkhe .pi himadyutau me nanirvṛtaṁ nirvṛtim samujhitajñātiviyogakhedaṁ tvatsaṁnidhāvucchvasatīva |
nirāspadaṁ praśnakutūhalitvam asmāsvadhīnaṁ kimu tathāpi kalyāṇakarīṁ giraṁ te māṁ śrotum icchā |
ity uktavān uktiviśeṣaramyaṁ manaḥ samādhāya udāracetā giram ityudārāṁ dvaipāyanenābhidadhe |
cicīṣatāṁ janmavatām alaghvīṁ yaśovataṁsām ubhayatra abhyarhitā bandhuṣu tulyarūpā vṛttir viśeṣeṇa |
tathāpi nighnaṁ nṛpa tāvakīnaiḥ prahvīkṛtaṁ me hṛdayaṁ vītaspṛhāṇām api muktibhājāṁ bhavanti bhavyeṣu hi |
sutā na yūyaṁ kimu tasya rājñaḥ suyodhanaṁ vā na guṇair yas tyaktavān vaḥ sa vṛthā balād vā mohaṁ vidhatte |
jahātu nainaṁ katham arthasiddhiḥ saṁśayya karṇādiṣu asādyuyogā hi jayāntarāyāḥ pramāthinīnāṁ vipadāṁ |
pathaś cyutāyāṁ samitau ripūṇāṁ dharmyāṁ dadhānena tvayā vipatsvapyavipatti ramyam āviṣkṛtaṁ prema paraṁ |
vidhāya vidhvaṁsanam ātmanīnaṁ śamaikavṛtter bhavataś prakāśitatvanmatiśīlasārāḥ kṛtopakārā iva vidviṣas te ||
labhyā dharitrī tava vikrameṇa jyāyāṁś ca vīryāstrabalair ataḥ prakarṣāya vidhir vidheyaḥ prakarṣatantrā hi raṇe |
triḥsaptakṛtvo jagatīpatīnāṁ hantā gurur yasya sa vīryāvadhūtaḥ sma tadā viveda prakarṣam ādhāravaśaṁ |
yasminn anaiśvaryakṛtavyalīkaḥ parābhavaṁ prāpta dhunvan dhanuḥ kasya raṇe na kuryān mano |
sṛjantam ājāviṣusaṁhatīr vaḥ saheta kopajvalitaṁ guruṁ parisphurallolaśikhāgrajihvaṁ jagajjighatsantam |
nirīkṣya saṁrambhanirastadhairyaṁ rādheyam asaṁstuteṣu prasabhaṁ bhayeṣu jāyeta mṛtyor api |
mahattvayogāya mahāmahimnām ārādhanīṁ tāṁ nṛpa dātuṁ pradānocita bhūridhāmnīm upāgataḥ siddhim |
ity uktavantaṁ vraja sādhayeti pramāṇayan vākyam prasedivāṁsaṁ tam upāsasāda vasann ivānte vinayena |
niryāya vidyātha dinādiramyād bimbād ivārkasya mukhān pārthānanaṁ vahnikaṇāvadātā dīptiḥ sphuratpadmam |
yogaṁ ca taṁ yogyatamāya tasmai tapaḥprabhāvād yenāsya tattveṣu kṛte .vabhāse samunmimīleva cirāya |
ākāram āśaṁsitabhūrilābhaṁ dadhānam niyojayiṣyan vijayodaye taṁ tapaḥsamādhau munir ity |
anena yogena vivṛddhatejā nijāṁ parasmai padavīm samācarācāram upāttaśastro japopavāsābhiṣavair munīnām |
kariṣyase yatra suduścarāṇi prasattaye gotrabhidas tapāṁsi śiloccayaṁ cāruśiloccayaṁ tam eṣa kṣaṇān neṣyati |
iti bruvāṇena mahendrasūnuṁ maharṣiṇā tena tirobabhūve taṁ rājarājānucaro .sya sākṣāt pradeśam ādeśam |
kṛtānatir vyāhṛtasāntvavāde jātaspṛhaḥ puṇyajanaḥ sa iyāya sakhyāviva samprasādaṁ viśvāsayatyāśu satāṁ hi |
athoṣṇabhāseva sumerukuñjān vihīyamānān udayāya tena bṛhaddyutīn duḥkhakṛtātmalābhaṁ tamaḥ śanaiḥ |
asaṁśayālocitakāryanunnaḥ premṇā samānīya tulyād vibhāgād iva tanmanobhir duḥkhātibhāro .pi laghuḥ |
dhairyeṇa viśvāsyatayā maharṣes tīvrād arātiprabhavācca vīryaṁ ca vidvatsu sute maghonaḥ sa teṣu na sthānam |
tān bhūridhāmnaścaturo .pi dūraṁ vihāya yāmān iva ekaughabhūtaṁ tad aśarma kṛṣṇāṁ vibhāvarīṁ dhvāntam |
tuṣāralekhākulitotpalābhe paryaśruṇī agūḍhabhāvāpi vilokane sā na locane mīlayituṁ viṣehe ||
akṛtrimapremarasābhirāmaṁ rāmārpitaṁ dṛṣṭivilobhi manaḥprasādāñjalinā nikāmaṁ jagrāha pātheyam |
dhairyāvasādena hṛtaprasādā vanyadvipeneva niruddhabāṣpodayasannakaṇṭham uvāca kṛcchrād iti |
magnāṁ dviṣacchadmani paṅkabhūte saṁbhavānāṁ ādhidviṣām ā tapasāṁ prasiddher asmad vinā mā bhṛśam |
yaśo .dhigantuṁ sukhalipsayā vā manuṣyasaṁkhyām nirutsukānām abhiyogabhājāṁ samutsukevāṅkam upaiti |
lokaṁ vidhātrā vihitasya goptuṁ kṣatrasya muṣṇan vasu tejasvitāyā vijayaikavṛtter nighnan priyaṁ prāṇam |
vrīḍānatair āptajanopanītaḥ saṁśayya kṛcchreṇa nṛpaiḥ vitānabhūtaṁ vitataṁ pṛthivyāṁ yaśaḥ samūhann iva |
vīryāvadāneṣu kṛtāvamarṣas tanvann abhūtām iva kurvan prayāmakṣayam āyatīnām arkatviṣām ahna |
prasahya yo .smāsu paraiḥ prayuktaḥ smartuṁ na śakyaḥ navīkariṣyatyupaśuṣyad ārdraḥ sa tvad vinā me hṛdayaṁ |
prāpto .bhimānavyasanād asahyaṁ dantīva dantavyasanād dviṣatpratāpāntaritorutejāḥ śaradghanākīrṇa ivādirahnaḥ ||
savrīḍamandair iva niṣkriyatvān nātyartham astrair yaśaḥkṣayakṣīṇajalārṇavābhas tvam anyam ākāram |
duḥśāsanāmarṣarajovikīrṇair ebhir vinārthair iva keśaiḥ kadarthīkṛtavīryasāraḥ kaccit sa evāsi dhanaṁjayas |
sa kṣattriyas trāṇasahaḥ satāṁ yas tat kārmukaṁ karmasu vahan dvayīṁ yady aphale .rthajāte karoty |
vītaujasaḥ sannidhimātraśeṣā bhavatkṛtāṁ bhūtim samānaduḥkhā iva nas tvadīyāḥ sarūpatāṁ pārtha guṇā |
ākṣipyamāṇaṁ ripubhiḥ pramādān nāgair ivālūnasaṭaṁ tvāṁ dhūr iyaṁ yogyatayādhirūḍhā dīptyā dinaśrīr iva |
karoti yo .śeṣajanātiriktāṁ sambhāvanām arthavatīṁ saṁsatsu jāte puruṣādhikāre na pūraṇī taṁ samupaiti |
priyeṣu yaiḥ pārtha vinopapatter vicintyamānaiḥ klamam tava prayātasya jayāya teṣāṁ kriyād aghānāṁ maghavā |
mā gāś cirāyaikacaraḥ pramādaṁ vasann asaṁbādhaśive mātsaryarāgopahatātmanāṁ hi skhalanti sādhuṣv api |
tad āśu kurvan vacanaṁ maharṣer manorathān naḥ pratyāgataṁ tvāsmi kṛtārtham eva stanopapīḍaṁ |
athābhipaśyann iva vidviṣaḥ puraḥ babhāra ramyo .pi vapuḥ sa bhīṣaṇaṁ gataḥ kriyāṁ mantra |
avilaṅghyavikarṣaṇaṁ paraiḥ prathitajyāravakarma agatāv aridṛṣṭigocaraṁ śitanistriṁśayujau maheṣudhī ||
yaśaseva tirodadhan muhur mahasā gotrabhidāyudhakṣatīḥ kavacaṁ ca saratnam udvahañjvalitajyotir ivāntaraṁ divaḥ |
akalādhipabhṛtyadarśitaṁ śivam urvīdharavartma hṛdayāni samāviveśa sa kṣaṇam udbāṣpadṛśāṁ tapobhṛtām |
anujagur atha divyaṁ dundubhidhvānam āśāḥ priyam iva kathayiṣyann āliliṅga sphurantīṁ bhuvam |
tataḥ sa kūjatkalahaṁsamekhalāṁ upāsasādopajanaṁ janapriyaḥ priyām ivāsāditayauvanāṁ |
vinamraśāliprasavaughaśālinīr apetapaṅkāḥ nananda paśyann upasīma sa sthalīr |
nirīkṣyamāṇā iva vismayākulaiḥ payobhir hṛtapriyādṛṣṭivilāsavibhramā mano .sya jahruḥ |
tutoṣa paśyan kalamasya sa adhikaṁ savārije vāriṇi sudurlabhe nārhati ko .bhinandituṁ prakarṣalakṣmīm |
nunoda tasya sthalapadminīgataṁ vitarkam avāptakiñjalkavibhedam uccakair vivṛttapāṭhīnaparāhataṁ |
kṛtormirekhaṁ śithilatvam āyatā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ śāntarayeṇa nirīkṣya reme sa samudrayoṣitāṁ taraṅgitakṣaumavipāṇḍu |
manoramaṁ prāpitam antaraṁ bhruvor alaṁkṛtaṁ alaktatāmrādharapallavaśriyā samānayantīm iva |
navātapālohitam āhitaṁ muhur mahāniveśau paritaḥ cakāsayantīm aravindajaṁ rajaḥ pariśramāmbhaḥpulakena |
kapolasaṁśleṣi vilocanatviṣā vibhūṣayantīm sutena pāṇḍoḥ kalamasya gopikāṁ nirīkṣya mene śaradaḥ |
upāratāḥ paścimarātrigocarād apārayantaḥ patituṁ javena tam utsukāś cakrur avekṣaṇotsukaṁ gavāṁ gaṇāḥ |
parītam ukṣāvajaye jayaśriyā nadantam uccaiḥ dadarśa puṣṭiṁ dadhataṁ sa śāradīṁ savigrahaṁ darpam |
vimucyamānair api tasya mantharaṁ gavāṁ śarannadīnāṁ pulinaiḥ kutūhalaṁ galaddukūlair jaghanair |
gatān paśūnāṁ sahajanmabandhutāṁ gṛhāśrayaṁ prema dadarśa gopān upadhenu pāṇḍavaḥ kṛtānukārān iva gobhir |
paribhraman mūrdhajaṣaṭpadākulaiḥ mukhaiś calatkuṇḍalaraśmirañjitair |
nibaddhaniḥśvāsavikampitādharā latā iva vyapoḍhapārśvair apavartitatrikā vikarṣaṇaiḥ |
vrajājireṣv ambudanādaśaṅkinīḥ śikhaṇḍinām muhuḥ praṇunneṣu mathāṁ vivartanair nadatsu kumbheṣu |
sa mantharāvalgitapīvarastanīḥ nirīkṣituṁ nopararāma ballavīr abhipranṛttā iva vārayoṣitaḥ |
papāta pūrvāṁ jahato vijihmatāṁ rathāṅgasīmantitasāndrakardamān |
janair upagrāmam anindyakarmabhir bhṛśaṁ dadarśāśramamaṇḍapopamāḥ sapuṣpahāsāḥ sa |
tataḥ sa samprekṣya śaradguṇaśriyaṁ uvāca yakṣas tam acodito .pi gāṁ na hīṅgitajño .vasare |
iyaṁ śivāyā niyater ivāyatiḥ kṛtārthayantī jagataḥ phalaiḥ jayaśriyaṁ pārtha pṛthūkarotu te śarat prasannāmbur |
upaiti sasyaṁ pariṇāmaramyatā nadīr anauddhatyam navair guṇaiḥ samprati saṁstavasthiraṁ tirohitaṁ prema |
patanti nāsmin viśadāḥ patatriṇo dhṛtendracāpā na tathāpi puṣṇāti nabhaḥ śriyaṁ parāṁ na ramyam āhāryam |
vipāṇḍubhir glānatayā payodharaiś iyaṁ kadambānilabhartur atyaye na digvadhūnāṁ kṛśatā |
vihāya vāñchām udite madātyayād araktakaṇṭhasya rute śrutiḥ śrayaty unmadahaṁsaniḥsvanaṁ guṇāḥ priyatve |
amī pṛthustambabhṛtaḥ piśaṅgatāṁ gatā vipākena phalasya vikāsi vaprāmbhasi gandhasūcitaṁ namanti nighrātum |
mṛṇālinīnām anurañjitaṁ tviṣā vibhinnam payaḥ sphuracchāliśikhāpiśaṅgitaṁ drutaṁ |
vipāṇḍu saṁvyānam ivāniloddhataṁ nirundhatīḥ anāvilonmīlitabāṇacakṣuṣaḥ sapuṣpahāsā vanarājiyoṣitaḥ ||
adīpitaṁ vaidyutajātavedasā tatāntaraṁ sāntaravāriśīkaraiḥ śivaṁ nabhovartma |
sitacchadānām apadiśya dhāvatāṁ rutair amīṣāṁ grathitāḥ prakurvate vāridarodhanirgatāḥ parasparālāpam ivāmalā |
vihārabhūmer abhighoṣam utsukāḥ śarīrajebhyaś asaktam ūdhāṁsi payaḥ kṣaranty amūr upāyanānīva |
jagatprasūtir jagadekapāvanī vrajopakaṇṭhaṁ tanayair dyutiṁ samagrāṁ samitir gavām asāv upaiti mantrair iva |
kṛtāvadhānaṁ jitabarhiṇadhvanau idaṁ jighatsām apahāya bhūyasīṁ na sasyam abhyeti |
asāv anāsthāparayāvadhīritaḥ saroruhiṇyā śirasā namann upaiti śuṣyan kalamaḥ sahāmbhasā manobhuvā tapta |
mukhair asau vidrumabhaṅgalohitaiḥ śikhāḥ piśaṅgīḥ śukāvalir vyaktaśirīṣakomalā dhanuḥśriyaṁ gotrabhido |
iti kathayati tatra nātidūrād atha dadṛśe vigalitajalabhāraśuklabhāsāṁ nicaya ivāmbumucāṁ |
tam atanuvanarājiśyāmitopatyakāntaṁ nagam upari vyapagatamadarāgasyānusasmāra lakṣmīm asitam |
atha jayāya nu merumahībhṛto rabhasayā nu abhiyayau sa himācalam ucchritaṁ samuditaṁ nu |
tapanamaṇḍaladītitam ekataḥ satatanaiśatamovṛtam hasitabhinnatamisracayaṁ puraḥ śivam ivānugataṁ |
kṣitinabhaḥsuralokanivāsibhiḥ kṛtaniketam prathayituṁ vibhutām abhinirmitaṁ pratinidhiṁ jagatām |
maṇimayūkhacayāṁśukabhāsurāḥ dadhatam uccaśilāntaragopurāḥ pura ivoditapuṣpavanā |
dadhatam ākaribhiḥ karibhiḥ kṣataiḥ samavatārasamair vividhakāmahitā mahitāmbhasaḥ sphuṭasarojavanā javanā |
navavinidrajapākusumatviṣāṁ dyutimatāṁ nikareṇa vihitasāṁdhyamayūkham iva kvacin nicitakāñcanabhittiṣu |
pṛthukadambakadambakarājitaṁ laghutuṣāratuṣārajalaścyutaṁ |
rahitaratnacayān na śiloccayān aphalatābhavanā na vipulināmburuhā na saridvadhūr akusumān dadhataṁ na |
vyathitasindhum anīraśanaiḥ śanair phaṇabhṛtām abhito vitataṁ tataṁ |
sasuracāpam anekamaṇiprabhair apapayoviśadaṁ avicalaṁ śikharair upabibhrataṁ dhvanitasūcitam |
vikacavāriruhaṁ dadhataṁ saraḥ sakalahaṁsagaṇaṁ śuci śivam agātmajayā ca kṛterṣyayā sakalahaṁ sagaṇaṁ |
grahavimānagaṇān abhito divaṁ jvalayatauṣadhijena muhur anusmarayantam anukṣapaṁ tripuradāham |
vitataśīkararāśibhir ucchritair upalarodhavivartibhir dadhatam unnatasānusamuddhatāṁ dhṛtasitavyajanām iva |
anucareṇa dhanādhipater atho sa jagade vacanaṁ priyam ādarān mukharatāvasare hi |
alam eṣa vilokitaḥ prajānāṁ sahasā saṁhatim aṁhasāṁ ghanavartma sahasradheva kurvan himagaurair |
iha duradhigamaiḥ kiṁcid evāgamaiḥ satatam asutaraṁ amum ativipinaṁ veda digvyāpinaṁ puruṣam iva paraṁ |
sulabhaiḥ sadā nayavatāyavatā nidhiguhyakādhiparamaiḥ amunā dhanaiḥ kṣitibhṛtātibhṛtā samatītya bhāti jagatī jagatī |
akhilam idam amuṣya gairīguros tribhuvanam api naiti adhivasati sadā yad enaṁ janair aviditavibhavo |
vītajanmajarasaṁ paraṁ śuci brahmaṇaḥ padam upaitum āgamād iva tamo.pahād itaḥ sambhavanti matayo |
divyastrīṇāṁ sacaraṇalākṣārāgā rāgāyāte pīḍābhājaḥ kusumacitāḥ sāśaṁsaṁ śaṁsanty asmin |
guṇasampadā samadhigamya paraṁ mahimānam atra nayaśālini śriya ivādhipatau viramanti na jvalitum |
kurarīgaṇaḥ kṛtaravas taravaḥ kusumānatāḥ sakamalaṁ iha sindhavaś ca varaṇāvaraṇāḥ kariṇāṁ mude |
sādṛśyaṁ gatam apanidracūtagandhair āmodaṁ etasmin madayati kokilān akāle līnāliḥ surakariṇāṁ |
sanākavanitaṁ nitambaruciraṁ ciraṁ suninadair nadair matā phalavato .vato rasaparā parāstavasudhā |
śrīmallatābhavanam oṣadhayaḥ pradīpāḥ śayyā navāni asmin ratiśramanudaś ca sarojavātāḥ smartuṁ diśanti na |
īśārtham ambhasi cirāya tapaś carantyā ālambatāgrakaram atra bhavo bhavānyāḥ |
yenāpaviddhasalilaḥ sphuṭanāgasadmā devāsurair amṛtam vyāvartanair ahipater ayam āhitāṅkaḥ khaṁ vyālikhann iva |
nītocchrāyaṁ muhur aśiśiraraśmer usrair ānīlābhair jyotsnāśaṅkām iva vitarati haṁsaśyenī madhye .py ahnaḥ |
dadhata iva vilāsaśāli nṛtyaṁ mṛdu patatā pavanena iha lalitavilāsinījanabhrūgatikuṭileṣu payaḥsu paṅkajāni ||
asminn agṛhyata pinākabhṛtā salīlam ābaddhavepathur vinyastamaṅgalamahauṣadhir īśvarāyāḥ |
krāmadbhir ghanapadavīm anekasaṁkhyais tejobhiḥ usrāṇāṁ vyabhicaratīva saptasapteḥ paryasyann iha |
vyadhatta yasmin puram uccagopuraṁ purāṁ vijetur sa eṣa kailāsa upāntasarpiṇaḥ karoty akālāstamayaṁ |
nānāratnajyotiṣāṁ saṁnipātaiś channeṣv antaḥsānu baddhāṁ baddhāṁ bhittiśaṅkām amuṣmin nāvānāvān |
ramyā navadyutir apaiti na śādvalebhyaḥ asmin vicitrakusumastabakācitānāṁ śākhābhṛtāṁ |
parisaraviṣayeṣu līḍhamuktā haritatṛṇodgamaśaṅkayā iha navaśukakomalā maṇīnāṁ ravikarasaṁvalitāḥ phalanti |
utphullasthalanalinīvanād amuṣmād uddhūtaḥ vātyābhir viyati vivartitaḥ samantād ādhatte |
iha saniyamayoḥ surāpagāyām uṣasi kathayati śivayoḥ śarīrayogaṁ viṣamapadā padavī |
saṁmūrchatāṁ rajatabhittimayūkhajālair gharmadyuter iha muhuḥ paṭalāni dhāmnām |
śuklair mayūkhanicayaiḥ parivītamūrtir śṛṅgāṇy amuṣya bhajate gaṇabhartur ukṣā kurvan |
samprati labdhajanma śanakaiḥ kathamapi laghuni khaṇḍitavigrahaṁ balabhido dhanur iha vividhāḥ |
snapitanavalatātarupravālair amṛtalavasrutiśālibhir satatam asitayāminīṣu śambho amalayatīha vanāntam |
kṣipati yo .nuvanaṁ vitatāṁ bṛhadbṛhatikām iva ayam anekahiraṇmayakaṁdaras tava pitur dayito |
saktiṁ lavād apanayatyanile latānāṁ vairocanairdviguṇitāḥ rodhobhuvāṁ muhur amutra hiraṇmayīnāṁ bhāsas |
kaṣaṇakampanirastamahāhibhiḥ iha madasnapitair anumīyate suragajasya gataṁ |
jaladajālaghanair asitāśmanām upahatapracayeha bhavati dīptir adīpitakaṁdarā timirasaṁvaliteva vivasvataḥ |
bhavyo bhavann api muner iha śāsanena kṣātre sthitaḥ prāyeṇa saty api hitārthakare vidhau hi śreyāṁsi labdhum |
mā bhūvann apathahṛtas tavendriyāśvāḥ saṁtāpe diśatu rakṣantas tapasi balaṁ ca lokapālāḥ kalyāṇīm |
ityuktvā sapadi hitaṁ priyaṁ priyārhe dhāma svaṁ sotkaṇṭhaṁ kimapi pṛthāsutaḥ pradadhyau saṁdhatte |
tam anatiśayanīyaṁ sarvataḥ sārayogād avirahitam akṛśam akṛśalakṣmīś cetasāśaṁsitaṁ sa svam iva |
rucirākṛtiḥ kanakasānum atho paramaḥ pumān iva patiṁ dhṛtasatpathas tripathagām abhitaḥ sa tam āruroha |
tam anindyabandina ivendrasutaṁ pavaneritākulavijihmaśikhā jagatīruho .vacakaruḥ |
uditopalaskhalanasaṁvalitāḥ mudam asya māṅgalikatūryakṛtāṁ dhvanayaḥ pratenur |
avarugṇatuṅgasuradārutarau nicaye puraḥ sa dadarśa vetasavanācaritāṁ praṇatiṁ balīyasi |
prababhūva nālam avalokayituṁ paritaḥ sariduttarīyam iva saṁhatimat sa taraṅgaraṅgi |
dadhati kṣatīḥ pariṇatadvirade muditāliyoṣiti adhikāṁ sa rodhasi babandha dhṛtiṁ mahate rujann api |
anuhemavapram aruṇaiḥ samatāṁ gatam ūrmibhiḥ sa rathāṅganāmavanitāṁ karuṇair anubadhnatīm |
upalāhatoddhatataraṅgadhṛtaṁ javinā vidhūtavitataṁ sa dadarśa ketakaśikhāviśadaṁ saritaḥ prahāsam iva |
bahu barhicandrikanibhaṁ vidadhe dhṛtim asya avagāḍham īkṣitum ivaibhapatiṁ vikasadvilocanaśataṁ |
pratibodhajṛmbhaṇavibhīnamukhī puline saroruhadṛśā patadacchamauktikamaṇiprakarā galadaśrubindur iva |
śucir apsu vidrumalatāviṭapas smaradāyinaḥ smarayati sma bhṛśaṁ dayitādharasya |
upalabhya cañcalataraṅgahṛtaṁ madagandham pratidantinām iva sa saṁbubudhe kariyādasām |
sa jagāma vismayam udvīkṣya puraḥ sahasā prahitaṁ divi prajavibhiḥ śvasitaiḥ śaradabhravibhramam |
sa tatāra saikatavatīr abhitaḥ śapharīparisphuritacārudṛśaḥ lalitāḥ sakhīr iva bṛhajjaghanāḥ suranimnagām upayatīḥ |
adhiruhya puṣpabharanamraśikhaiḥ paritaḥ pariṣkṛtatalāṁ manasaḥ prasattim iva mūrdhni gireḥ śucim āsasāda sa |
praṇidhāya tatra vidhinātha dhiyaṁ dadhataḥ śramam ādadhāv asukaraṁ na tapaḥ kim ivāvasādakaram |
śamayan dhṛtendriyaśamaikasukhaḥ śucibhir guṇair prativāsaraṁ sukṛtibhir vavṛdhe vimalaḥ kalābhir iva |
adharīcakāra ca vivekaguṇād aguṇeṣu tasya dhiyam pratighātinīṁ viṣayasaṅgaratiṁ nirupaplavaḥ |
manasā japaiḥ praṇatibhiḥ prayataḥ samupeyivān sahajetare jayaśamau dadhatī bibharāṁbabhūva yugapan |
śirasā harinmaṇinibhaḥ sa vahan kṛtajanmano .bhiṣavaṇena upamāṁ yayāv aruṇadīdhitibhiḥ parimṛṣṭamūrdhani |
dhṛtahetir apy adhṛtajihmamatiś caritair munīn rajayāṁcakāra virajāḥ sa mṛgān kam iveśate ramayituṁ na |
anukūlapātinam acaṇḍagatiṁ kiratā sugandhim abhitaḥ avadhīritārtavaguṇaṁ sukhatāṁ nayatā rucāṁ nicayam |
navapallavāñjalibhṛtaḥ pracaye bṛhatas tarūn stṛṇatā tṛṇaiḥ pratiniśaṁ mṛdubhiḥ śayanīyatām upayatīṁ |
patitair apetajaladān nabhasaḥ pṛṣatair apāṁ śamayatā ca sa dayāluneva parigāḍhakṛśaḥ paricaryayānujagṛhe tapasā |
mahate phalāya tad avekṣya śivaṁ na jagāma vismayavaśaṁ vaśināṁ na nihanti dhairyam |
tad abhūrivāsarakṛtaṁ sukṛtair upalabhya vaibhavam upatasthur āsthitaviṣādadhiyaḥ śatayajvano vanacarā |
viditāḥ praviśya vihitānatayaḥ śithilīkṛte anapetakālam abhirāmakathāḥ kathayāṁbabhūvur iti |
śucivalkavītatanur anyatamas timiracchidām iva girau mahate jayāya maghavann anaghaḥ puruṣas tapasyati |
sa bibharti bhīṣaṇabhujaṁgabhujaḥ pṛthi vidviṣāṁ amalena tasya dhṛtasaccaritāś caritena cātiśayitā munayaḥ |
marutaḥ śivā navatṛṇā jagatī vimalaṁ nabho rajasi vṛṣṭir guṇasampadānuguṇatāṁ gamitaḥ kurute .sya bhaktim iva |
itaretarānabhibhavena mṛgās tam upāsate gurum vinamanti cāsya taravaḥ pracaye paravān sa tena bhavateva |
uru sattvam āha vipariśramatā paramaṁ vapuḥ śamino .pi tasya navasaṁgamane vibhutānuṣaṅgi bhayam |
ṛṣivaṁśajaḥ sa yadi daityakule yadi vānvaye mahati caratas tapas tava vaneṣu sadā na vayaṁ nirūpayitum asya |
vigaṇayya kāraṇam anekaguṇaṁ nijayāthavā kathitam asad apy adaḥ sahitum arhati naḥ kva vanecarāḥ kva |
adhigamya guhyakagaṇād iti tan manasaḥ priyaṁ nijugopa harṣam uditaṁ maghavā nayavartmagāḥ |
praṇidhāya cittam atha bhaktatayā vidite .py apūrva iva upalabdhum asya niyamasthiratāṁ surasundarīr iti vaco |
sukumāram ekam aṇu marmabhidām atidūragaṁ yutam avipakṣam astram aparaṁ katamad vijayāya yūyam iva |
bhavavītaye hatabṛhattamasām avabodhavāri rajasaḥ paripīyamāṇam iva vo .sakalair avasādam eti |
bahudhā gatāṁ jagati bhūtasṛjā kamanīyatāṁ samabhihṛtya upapāditā vidadhatā bhavatīḥ surasadmayānasumukhī |
tad upetya vighnayata tasya tapaḥ kṛtibhiḥ kalāsu sahitāḥ hṛtavītarāgamanasāṁ nanu vaḥ sukhasaṅginaṁ prati |
avimṛṣyam etad abhilaṣyati sa dviṣatāṁ vadhena bhavavītaye na hi tathā sa vidhiḥ kva śarāsanaṁ kva ca |

nivṛttavṛttorupayodharaklamaḥ nitambinīnāṁ bhṛśam ādadhe dhṛtiṁ nabhaḥprayāṇād |
ghanāni kāmaṁ kusumāni bibhrataḥ karapraceyāny puro .bhisasre surasundarījanair yathottarecchā hi guṇeṣu |
tanūr alaktāruṇapāṇipallavāḥ vilāsinībāhulatā vanālayo vilepanāmodahṛtāḥ siṣevire ||
nipīyamānastabakā śilīmukhair aśokayaṣṭiś calabālapallavā viḍambayantī dadṛśe vadhūjanair |
karau dhunānā navapallavākṛtī vṛthā kṛthā mānini mā upeyuṣī kalpalatābhiśaṅkayā kathaṁ nv itas trasyati |

drāghīyasā vayo.tītaḥ pariklāntaḥ kilādhvanā ||
jaṭānāṁ kīrṇayā keśaiḥ saṁhatyā paritaḥ sitaiḥ |

viśadabhrūyugacchannavalitāpāṅgalocanaḥ |
prāleyāvatatimlānapalāśābja iva hradaḥ ||
āsaktabharanīkāśair aṅgaiḥ parikṛśair api |
adyūnaḥ sadgṛhiṇy eva prāyo yaṣṭyāvalambitaḥ ||
gūḍho .pi vapuṣā rājan dhāmnā lokābhibhāvinā |
aṁśumān iva tanvabhrapaṭalacchannavigrahaḥ ||
jaratīm api bibhrāṇas tanum aprākṛtākṛtiḥ |
cakārākrāntalakṣmīkaḥ sasādhvasam ivāśrayam ||
abhitas taṁ pṛthāsūnuḥ snehena paritastare |
avijñāte .pi bandhau hi balāt prahlādate manaḥ ||
ātitheyīm athāsādya sutādapacitiṁ hariḥ |
viśramya viṣṭare nāma vyājahāreti bhāratīm ||
tvayā sādhu samārambhi nave vayasi yat tapaḥ |
hriyate viṣayaiḥ prāyo varṣīyān api mādṛśaḥ ||
śreyasīṁ tava samprāptā guṇasampadam ākṛtiḥ |
sulabhā ramyatā loke durlabhaṁ hi guṇārjanam ||
śaradambudharacchāyā gatvaryo yauvanaśriyaḥ |
āpātaramyā viṣayāḥ paryantaparitāpinaḥ ||
antakaḥ paryavasthātā janminaḥ saṁtatāpadaḥ |
iti tyājye bhave bhavyo muktāv uttiṣṭhate manaḥ ||
cittavān asi kalyāṇī yat tvāṁ matir upasthitā |
viruddhaḥ kevalaṁ veṣaḥ saṁdehayati me manaḥ ||
yuyutsuneva kavacaṁ kim āmuktam idaṁ tvayā |
tapasvino hi vasate kevalājinavalkale ||
prapitsoḥ kiṁ ca te muktiṁ niḥspṛhasya kalevare |
maheṣudhī dhanur bhīmaṁ bhūtānām anabhidruhaḥ ||
bhayaṁkaraḥ prāṇabhṛtāṁ mṛtyor bhuja ivāparaḥ |
asis tava tapasthasya na samarthayate śamam ||
jayam atrabhavān nūnam arātiṣv abhilāṣukaḥ |
krodhalakṣma kṣamāvantaḥ kvāyudhaṁ kva tapodhanāḥ ||
yaḥ karoti vadhodarkā niḥśreyasakarīḥ kriyāḥ |
glānidoṣacchidaḥ svacchāḥ sa mūḍhaḥ paṅkayaty apaḥ ||
mūlaṁ doṣasya hiṁsāder arthakāmau sma mā puṣaḥ |
tau hi tattvāvabodhasya durucchedāv upaplavau ||
abhidroheṇa bhūtānām arjayan gatvarīḥ śriyaḥ |
udanvān iva sindhūnām āpadām eti pātratām ||
yā gamyāḥ satsahāyānāṁ yāsu khedo bhayaṁ yataḥ |
tāsāṁ kiṁ yan na duḥkhāya vipadām iva sampadām ||
durāsadān arīn ugrān dhṛter viśvāsajanmanaḥ |
bhogān bhogān ivāheyān adhyāsyāpan na durlabhā ||
nāntarajñāḥ śriyo jātu priyair āsāṁ na bhūyate |

ko .pavādaḥ stutipade yad aśīleṣu cañcalāḥ |

pratyāsīdati muktis tvāṁ purā mā bhūr udāyudhaḥ ||

prasādaramyam ojasvi garīyo lāghavānvitam |
sākāṅkṣam anupaskāraṁ viṣvaggati nirākulam ||
nyāyanirṇītasāratvān nirapekṣam ivāgame |
aprakampyatayānyeṣām āmnāyavacanopamam ||
alaṅghyatvājjanair anyaiḥ kṣubhitodanvadūrjitam |
audāryād arthasampatteḥ śāntaṁ cittam ṛṣer iva ||
idam īdṛgguṇopetaṁ labdhāvasarasādhanam |
vyākuryāt kaḥ priyaṁ vākyaṁ yo vaktā nedṛgāśayaḥ ||

vrajaty aphalatām eva nayadruha ivehitam ||

nabhasaḥ sphuṭatārasya rātrer iva viparyayaḥ ||

sthityatikrāntibhīrūṇi svacchāny ākulitāny api |

apavādād abhītasya samasya guṇadoṣayoḥ |
asadvṛtter ahovṛttaṁ durvibhāvaṁ vidher iva ||
dhvaṁseta hṛdayaṁ sadyaḥ paribhūtasya me paraiḥ |
yady amarṣaḥ pratīkāraṁ bhujālambaṁ na lambhayet ||
avadhūyāribhir nītā hariṇais tulyavṛttitām |
anyonyasyāpi jihrīmaḥ kiṁ punaḥ sahavāsinām ||
śaktivaikalyanamrasya niḥsāratvāl laghīyasaḥ |
janmino mānahīnasya tṛṇasya ca samā gatiḥ ||
alaṅghyaṁ tat tad udvīkṣya yad yad uccair mahībhṛtām |
priyatāṁ jyāyasīṁ mā gān mahatāṁ kena tuṅgatā ||

sa pumān arthavaj janmā yasya nāmni puraḥsthite |
nānyām aṅgulim abhyeti saṁkhyāyām udyatāṅguliḥ ||
durāsadavanajyāyān gamyas tuṅgo .pi bhūdharaḥ |
na jahāti mahaujaskaṁ mānaprāṁśum alaṅghyatā ||
gurūn kurvanti te vaṁśyān anvarthā tair vasuṁdharā |
yeṣāṁ yaśāṁsi śubhrāṇi hrepayantīndumaṇḍalam ||
udāharaṇam āśiḥṣu prathame te manasvinām |
śuṣke .śanir ivāmarṣo yair arātiṣu pātyate ||
na sukhaṁ prārthaye nārtham udanvadvīcicañcalam |
nānityatāśanes trasyan viviktaṁ brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
pramārṣṭum ayaśaḥpaṅkam iccheyaṁ chadmanā kṛtam |
vaidhavyatāpitārātivanitālocanāmbubhiḥ ||
apahasye .thavā sadbhiḥ pramādo vāstu me dhiyaḥ |
asthānavihitāyāsaḥ kāmaṁ jihretu vā bhavān ||
vaṁśalakṣmīm anuddhṛtya samucchedena vidviṣām |
nirvāṇam api manye .ham antarāyaṁ jayaśriyaḥ ||
ajanmā puruṣas tāvad gatāsus tṛṇam eva vā |
yāvan neṣubhir ādatte viluptam aribhir yaśaḥ ||
anirjayena dviṣatāṁ yasyāmarṣaḥ praśāmyati |
puruṣoktiḥ kathaṁ tasmin brūhi tvaṁ hi tapodhana ||
kṛtaṁ puruṣaśabdena jātimātrāvalambinā |
yo .ṅgīkṛtaguṇaiḥ ślāghyaḥ savismayam udāhṛtaḥ ||
grasamānam ivaujāṁsi sadasā gauraveritam |
nāma yasyābhinandanti dviṣo .pi sa pumān pumān ||
yathāpratijñaṁ dviṣatāṁ yudhi praticikīrṣayā |
mamaivādhyeti nṛpatis tṛṣyann iva jalāñjaleḥ ||
sa vaṁśasyāvadātasya śaśāṅkasyeva lāñchanam |
kṛcchreṣu vyarthayā yatra bhūyate bhartur ājñayā ||
kathaṁ vādīyatām arvāṅ munitā dharmarodhinī |
āśramānukramaḥ pūrvaiḥ smaryate na vyatikramaḥ ||
āsaktā dhūr iyaṁ rūḍhā jananī dūragā ca me |
tiraskaroti svātantryaṁ jyāyāṁś cācāravān nṛpaḥ ||
svadharmam anurundhante nātikramam arātibhiḥ |
palāyante kṛtadhvaṁsā nāhavān mānaśālinaḥ ||
vicchinnābhravilāyaṁ vā vilīye nagamūrdhani |
ārādhya vā sahasrākṣam ayaśaḥśalyam uddhare ||
ity uktavantaṁ parirabhya dorbhyāṁ tanūjam aghopaghātaṁ maghavā vibhūtyai bhavodbhavārādhanam |
prīte pinākini mayā saha lokapālair lokatraye .pi lakṣmīṁ samutsukayitāsi bhṛśaṁ pareṣām uccārya vācam |
marutāṁ patiḥ svid ahimāṁśur uta pṛthuśikhaḥ śikhī tapaḥ taptum asukaram upakramate na jano .yam ity avayaye sa |
atha bhūtabhavyabhavadīśam abhimukhayituṁ kṛtastavāḥ tatra mahasi dadṛśuḥ puruṣaṁ kamanīyavigraham |
pariṇāhinā tuhinarāśiviśadam upavītasūtratām |
nītam uragam anurañjayatā śitinā galena vilasanmarīcinā ||
sa dhanurmaheṣudhi bibharti kavacam asitam uttamaṁ valkam ajinam iti citram idaṁ munitāvirodhi na ca nāsya |
sa tam āsasāda ghananīlam abhimukham upasthitaṁ pitranikaṣaṇavibhinnabhuvaṁ danujaṁ dadhānam atha |
kacchānte surasarito nidhāya senām anvatiḥ sa katipayaiḥ pracchannas tarugahanaiḥ sagulmajālair lakṣmīvān |
vapuṣāṁ parameṇa bhūdharāṇām atha mṛgam āśu vilokayāṁcakāra sthiradaṁṣṭrogramukhaṁ |
sphuṭabaddhasaṭonnatiḥ sa dūrād abhidhāvann jayam icchati tasya jātaśaṅke manasīmaṁ muhur ādade |
ghanapotravidīrṇaśālamūlo ayam ekacaro .bhivartate māṁ samarāyeva |
iha vītabhayās tapo.nubhāvājjahati vyālamṛgāḥ pareṣu mayi tāṁ sutarām ayaṁ vidhatte vikṛtiḥ kiṁ nu bhaved |
athavaiṣa kṛtajñayeva pūrvaṁ bhṛśam āsevitayā ruṣā na avadhūya virodhinīḥ kim ārān mṛgajātīr abhiyāti māṁ |
na mṛgaḥ khalu ko .py ayaṁ jighāṁsuḥ skhalati hy atra vimalaṁ kaluṣībhavac ca cetaḥ kathayaty eva hitaiṣiṇaṁ |
munir asmi nirāgasaḥ kuto me bhayam ity eṣa na bhūtaye paravṛddhiṣu baddhamatsarāṇāṁ kim iva hy asti |
danujaḥ svid ayaṁ kṣapācaro vā vanaje neti balaṁ bad asti abhibhūya tathā hi meghanīlaḥ sakalaṁ kampayatīva |
ayam eva mṛgavyasattrakāmaḥ prahariṣyan mayi māyayā pṛthubhir dhvajinīsravair akārṣīccakitodbhrāntamṛgāṇi |
bahuśaḥ kṛtasatkṛter vidhātuṁ priyam icchann athavā kṣubhitaṁ vanagocarābhiyogād gaṇam āśiśriyad ākulaṁ |
avalīḍhasanābhir aśvasenaḥ prasabhaṁ pratikartum upāgataḥ samanyuḥ kṛtamanyur yadi vā |
balaśālitayā yathā tathā vā dhiyam ucchedaparāmayaṁ niyamena mayā nibarhaṇīyaḥ paramaṁ lābham |
kuru tāta tapāṁsy amārgadāyī vijayāyetyalam anvaśān balinaś ca vadhād ṛte .sya śakyaṁ vrasaṁrakṣaṇam |
iti tena vicintya cāpanāma prathamaṁ pauruṣacihnam upalabdhaguṇaḥ parasya bhede sacivaḥ śuddha ivādade ca |
anubhāvavatā guru sthiratvād avisaṁvādi dhanur svabalavyasane .pi pīḍyamānaṁ guṇavan mitram ivānatiṁ |
pravikarṣaninādabhinnarandhraḥ padaviṣṭambhanipīḍitas adhirohati gāṇḍivaṁ maheṣau sakalaḥ saṁśayam āruroha |
dadṛśe .tha savismayaṁ śivena racitas tisṛṇāṁ purāṁ vidhātuṁ vadham ātmeva |
vicakarṣa ca saṁhiteṣur uccaiś dhanurāyatabhogavāsukijyāvadanagranthivimuktavahni |
sa bhavasya bhavakṣayaikahetoḥ sitasapteś ca vidhāsyatoḥ ripur āpa parābhavāya madhyaṁ prakṛtipratyayayor |
vrajato .sya bṛhatpatatrajanmā pratinādamahān mahoragāṇāṁ hṛdayaśrotrabhid utpapāta |
nayanād iva śūlinaḥ pravṛttair manaso .py āśutaraṁ yataḥ vidadhe vilasattaḍillatābhaiḥ kiraṇair vyomani mārgaṇasya |
apayan dhanuṣaḥ śivāntikasthair vivaresadbhir abhikhyayā yugapad dadṛśe viśan varāhaṁ tadupoḍhaiś ca |
sa tamālanibhe ripau surāṇāṁ ghananīhāra ivāviṣaktavegaḥ bhayaviplutam īkṣito nabhaḥsthair jagatīṁ grāha ivāpagāṁ |
sapadi priyarūpaparvarekhaḥ sitalohāgranakhaḥ kham kupitāntakatarjanāṅguliśrīr vyathayan prāṇabhṛtaḥ |
paramāstraparigrahorutejaḥ sphuradulkākṛti vikṣipan sa javena patan paraḥśatānāṁ patatāṁ vrāta ivāravaṁ |
avibhāvitaniṣkramaprayāṇaḥ śamitāyāma ivātiraṁhasā saḥ saha pūrvataraṁ nu cittavṛtter apatitvā nu cakāra |
sa vṛṣadhvajasāyakāvabhinnaṁ jayahetuḥ pratikāyam laghu sādhayituṁ śaraḥ prasehe vidhinevārtham udīritaṁ |
avivekavṛthāśramāvivārthaṁ kṣayalobhāv iva vijigīṣum ivānayapramādāv avasādaṁ viśikhau vininyatus |
atha dīrghatamaṁ tamaḥ pravekṣyan sahasā rugṇarayaḥ sa nipatantam ivoṣṇaraśmim urvyāṁ valayībhūtataruṁ |
sa gataḥ kṣitim uṣṇaśoṇitārdraḥ asubhiḥ kṣaṇam īkṣitendrasūnur vihitāmarṣagurudhvanir |
sphuṭapauruṣam āpapāta pārthas tam atha prājyaśaraḥ na tathā kṛtavedināṁ kariṣyan priyatām eti yathā |
upakāra ivāsati prayuktaḥ sthitim aprāpya mṛge gataḥ kṛtaśaktir avāṅmukho gurutvāj janitavrīḍa |
sa samuddharatā vicintya tena svarucaṁ kīrtim ivottamāṁ anuyukta iva svavārtam uccaiḥ parirebhe nu bhṛśaṁ |
tatra kārmukabhṛtaṁ mahābhujaḥ paśyati sma sahasā saṁnikāśayitum agrataḥ sthitaṁ śāsanaṁ |
śāntatā vinayayogi mānasaṁ bhūridhāma vimalaṁ tapaḥ prāha te nu sadṛśī divaukasām anvavāyam avadātam ākṛtiḥ |
dīpitas tvam anubhāvasampadā gauraveṇa laṅghayan rājase munir apīha kārayann ādhipatyam iva |
tāpaso .pi vibhutām upeyivān āspadaṁ tvam asi dṛśyate hi bhavato vinā janair anvitasya sacivair iva dyutiḥ |
hrepayann ahimatejasaṁ tviṣā sa tvam ittham hartum arhasi varāhabhedinaṁ nainam asmadadhipasya |
smaryate tanubhṛtāṁ sanātanaṁ nyāyyam ācaritam dhvaṁsate yadi bhavādṛśas tataḥ kaḥ prayātu vada tena |
ākumāram upadeṣṭum icchavaḥ saṁnivṛttim apathān yogaśaktijitajanmamṛtyavaḥ śīlayanti yatayaḥ suśīlatām ||
tiṣṭhatāṁ tapasi puṇyam āsajan sampado .nuguṇayan yogināṁ pariṇaman vimuktaye kena nāstu vinayaḥ satāṁ |
nūnam atrabhavataḥ śarākṛtiṁ sarvathāyam anuyāti so .yam ity anupapannasaṁśayaḥ kāritas tvam apathe |
anyadīyaviśikhe na kevalaṁ niḥspṛhasya bhavitavyam nighnataḥ paranibarhitaṁ mṛgaṁ vrīḍitavyam api te |
saṁtataṁ niśamayanta utsukā yaiḥ prayānti mudam asya kīrtitāni hasite .pi tāni yaṁ vrīḍayanti caritāni māninam ||
anyadoṣam iva saḥ svakaṁ guṇaṁ khyāpayet katham ucyate sa khalu kāryavattayā dhig vibhinnabudhasetum |
durvacaṁ tad atha mā sma bhūn mṛgas tvāv asau yad nainam āśu yadi vāhinīpatiḥ pratyapatsyata śitena pattriṇā |
ko nv imaṁ harituraṅgam āyudhastheyasīṁ dadhatam vegavattaramṛte camūpater hantum arhati śareṇa |
mitram iṣṭam upakāri saṁśaye medinīpatir ayaṁ tathā ca te taṁ virodhya bhavatā nirāsi mā sajjanaikavasatiḥ kṛtajñatā |
labhyam ekasukṛtena durlabhā rakṣitāram svantam antavirasā jigīṣatāṁ mitralābham anu |
cañcalaṁ vasu nitāntam unnatā medinīm api haranty bhūdharasthiram upeyam āgataṁ māvamaṁsta suhṛdaṁ |
jetum eva bhavatā tapasyate nāyudhāni dadhate prāpsyate ca sakalaṁ mahībhṛtā saṁgatena tapasaḥ phalaṁ |
vājibhūmir ibharājakānanaṁ santi ratnanicayāś ca bhūriśaḥ kāñcanena kim ivāsya pattriṇā kevalaṁ na sahate |
tat tadīyaviśikhātisarjanād astu vāṁ guru yadṛcchayāgatam rāghavaplavagarājayor iva prema yuktam itaretarāśrayam |
nābhiyoktum anṛtaṁ tvam iṣyate kastapasviviśikheṣu santi bhūbhṛti śarā hi naḥ pare ye parākramavasūni |
mārgaṇair atha tava prayojanaṁ nāthase kimu patiṁ na tvadvidhaṁ suhṛdam etya sa arthinaṁ kiṁ na yacchati |
tena sūrir upakāritādhanaḥ kartum icchati na yācitaṁ vṛthā sīdatām anubhavann ivārthināṁ veda yat |
śaktir arthapatiṣu svayaṁgrahaṁ prema kārayati vā kāraṇadvayam idaṁ nirasyataḥ prārthanādhikabale |
astravedam adhigamya tattvataḥ kasya ceha jāmadagnyam apahāya gīyate tāpaseṣu caritārtham |
abhyaghāni municāpalāt tvayā yan mṛgaḥ kṣitipateḥ akṣamiṣṭa tad ayaṁ pramādyatāṁ saṁvṛṇoti khalu doṣam |
janmaveṣatapasāṁ virodhinīṁ mā kṛthāḥ punar amūm āpad ety ubhayalokadūṣaṇī vartamānam apathe hi |
yaṣṭum icchasi pitṝn na sāmprataṁ saṁvṛto .rcicayiṣur dātum eva padavīm api kṣamaḥ kiṁ mṛge .ṅga viśikhaṁ |
tat titikṣitam idaṁ mayā muner ity avocata vacaś bāṇam atrabhavate nijaṁ diśann āpnuhi tvam api |
ātmanīnam upatiṣṭhate guṇāḥ sambhavanti viramanti ity anekaphalabhāji mā sma bhūd arthitā katham |
sajyaṁ dhanur vahati yo .hipatisthavīyaḥ stheyāñ jayan asyānukūlaya matiṁ matimann anena sakhyā sukhaṁ |
tataḥ kirātasya vacobhir uddhataiḥ parāhataḥ śaila jahau na dhairyaṁ kupito .pi pāṇḍavaḥ |
saleśam ulliṅgitaśātraveṅgitaḥ kṛtī girāṁ ayaṁ pramāṇīkṛtakālasādhanaḥ praśāntasaṁrambha |
viviktavarṇābharaṇā sukhaśrutiḥ prasādayantī hṛdayāny pravartate nākṛtapuṇyakarmaṇāṁ prasannagambhīrapadā |
bhavanti te sabhyatamā vipaścitāṁ manogataṁ vāci nayanti teṣv apy upapannanaipuṇā gambhīram arthaṁ |
stuvanti gurvīm abhidheyasampadaṁ viśuddhimukter iti sthitāyāṁ pratipūruṣaṁ rucau sudurlabhāḥ |
samasya sampādayatā guṇair imāṁ tvayā samāropitabhāra pragalbham ātmā dhuri dhurya vāgmināṁ vanacareṇāpi |
prayujya sāmācaritaṁ vilobhanaṁ bhayaṁ vibhedāya tathābhiyuktaṁ ca śilīmukhārthinā yathetaran nyāyyam |
virodhi siddher iti kartum udyataḥ sa vāritaḥ kiṁ bhavatā hite niyojyaḥ khalu bhūtim icchatā sahārthanāśena nṛpo |
dhruvaṁ praṇāśaḥ prahitasya pattriṇaḥ śiloccaye tasya na yuktam atrāryajanātilaṅghanaṁ diśaty apāyaṁ hi satām |
atītasaṁkhyā vihitā mamāgninā śilāmukhāḥ khāṇḍavam anādṛtasyāmarasāyakeṣv api sthitā kathaṁ śailajanāśuge |
yadi pramāṇīkṛtam āryaceṣṭitaṁ kim ity adoṣeṇa tiraskṛtā ayātapūrvā parivādagocaraṁ satāṁ hi vāṇī guṇam eva |
guṇāpavādena tadanyaropaṇād bhṛśādhirūḍhasya dvidheva kṛtvā hṛdayaṁ nigūhataḥ sphurad asādhor |
vanāśrayāḥ kasya mṛgāḥ parigrahāḥ śṛṇāti yas tān prahīyatām atra nṛpeṇa mānitā na mānitā cāsti bhavanti ca |
na vartma kasmaicid api pradīyatām iti vrataṁ me vihitaṁ jighāṁsur asmān nihato mayā mṛgo vratābhirakṣā hi satām |
mṛgān vinighnan mṛgayuḥ svahetunā kṛtopakāraḥ katham kṛpeti ced astu mṛgaḥ kṣataḥ kṣaṇād anena pūrvaṁ na |
anāyudhe sattvajighāṁsite munau kṛpeti vṛttir mahatām śarāsanaṁ bibhrati sajyasāyakaṁ kṛtānukampaḥ sa kathaṁ |
atho śaras tena madartham ujjhitaḥ phalaṁ ca tasya avikṣate tatra mayātmasātkṛte kṛtārthatā nanv adhikā |
yad āttha kāmaṁ bhavatā sa yācyatām iti kṣamaṁ naitad kathaṁ prasahyāharaṇaiṣiṇāṁ priyaḥ parāvanatyā |
abhūtam āsajya viruddham īhitaṁ balād alabhyaṁ tava vijānato .pi hy anayasya raudratāṁ bhavaty apāye |
asiḥ śarā varma dhanuś ca noccakair vivicya kiṁ prārthitam athāsti śaktiḥ kṛtam eva yācñayā na dūṣitaḥ śaktimatāṁ |
sakhā sa yuktaḥ kathitaḥ kathaṁ tvayā yadṛcchayāsūyati guṇārjanocchrāyaviruddhabuddhayaḥ prakṛtyamitrā hi |
vayaṁ kva varṇāśramarakṣaṇocitāḥ kva jātihīnā sahāpakṛṣṭair mahatāṁ na saṁgataṁ bhavanti |
paro .vajānāti yad ajñatājaḍas tad unnatānāṁ na vihanti samānavīryānvayapauruṣeṣu yaḥ karoty atikrāntim asau |
yadā vigṛhṇāti hataṁ tadā yaśaḥ karoti maitrīm atha dūṣitā sthitiṁ samīkṣyobhayathā parīkṣakaḥ karoty |
mayā mṛgān hantur anena hetunā viruddham ākṣepavacas śarārtham eṣyaty atha lapsyate gatiṁ śiromaṇiṁ dṛṣṭiviṣāj |
tato .pavādena patākinīpateś cacāla nirhrādavatī yugāntavātābhihateva kurvatī ninādam |
raṇāya jaitraḥ pradiśann iva tvarāṁ puro balānāṁ saghanāmbuśīkaraḥ śanaiḥ pratasthe |
jayāravakṣveḍitanādamūrchitaḥ asambhavan bhūdhararājakukṣiṣu prakampayan gām |
niśātaraudreṣu vikāsatāṁ gataiḥ pradīpayadbhiḥ vanesadāṁ hetiṣu bhinnavigrahair vipusphure raśmimato |
udūḍhavakṣaḥsthagitaikadiṅmukho vitatya pakṣadvayam āyataṁ babhau vibhur guṇānām |
sugeṣu durgeṣu ca tulyavikramair javād ahaṁpūrvikayā gaṇair avicchedaniruddham ābabhau vanaṁ nirucchvāsam |
tirohitaśvabhranikuñcarodhasaḥ samaśnuvānāḥ kirātasainyair apidhāya recitā bhuvaḥ kṣaṇaṁ nimnatayeva |
tataḥ sadarpaṁ pratanuṁ tapasyayā madasrutikṣāmam parijvalantaṁ nidhanāya bhūbhṛtāṁ dahantam āśā iva |
anādaropāttadhṛtaikasāyakaṁ jaye .nukūle suhṛdīva śanair apūrṇapratikārapelave niveśayantaṁ nayane |
niṣaṇṇam āpatpratikārakāraṇe śarāsane dhairya alaṅghanīyaṁ prakṛtāv api sthitaṁ nivātaniṣkampam |
upeyuṣīṁ bibhratam antakadyutiṁ vadhād adūre patitasya puraḥ samāveśitasatpaśuṁ dvijaiḥ patiṁ paśūnām iva |
nijena nītaṁ vijitānyagauravaṁ gabhīratāṁ dhairyaguṇena vanodayeneva ghanoruvīrudhā samandhakārīkṛtam |
maharṣabhaskandham anūnakaṁdharaṁ samujjihīrṣuṁ jagatīṁ mahābharāṁ mahāvarāhaṁ mahato |
harinmaṇiśyāmam udagravigrahaṁ prakāśamānaṁ manuṣyabhāve puruṣaṁ purātanaṁ sthitaṁ jalādarśa |
gurukriyārambhaphalair alaṁkṛtaṁ gatiṁ pratāpasya gaṇāḥ samāsedur anīlavājinaṁ tapātyaye toyaghanā ghanā |
yathāsvam āśaṁsitavikramāḥ purā yayuḥ kṣaṇād apratipattimūḍhatāṁ mahānubhāvaḥ |
tataḥ prajahre samam eva tatra tair mahodayānām api saṁghavṛttitāṁ sahāyasādhyāḥ |
kirātasainyād urucāpanoditāḥ samaṁ samutpetur mahāvanād unmanasaḥ khagā iva pravṛttapattradhvanayaḥ |
gabhīrarandhreṣu bhṛśaṁ mahībhṛtaḥ pratisvanair dhanurninādena javād upeyuṣā vibhidyamānā iva |
vidhūnayantī gahanāni bhūruhāṁ mahīyasī vṛṣṭir ivānileritā ravaṁ vitene gaṇamārgaṇāvaliḥ |
trayīm ṛtūnām anilāśinaḥ sataḥ prayāti poṣaṁ vapuṣi raṇāya jiṣṇor viduṣeva satvaraṁ ghanatvam īye śithilena |
patatsu śastreṣu vitatya rodasī samantatas tasya dhanur saroṣam ulkeva papāta bhīṣaṇā baleṣu dṛṣṭir |
diśaḥ samūhann iva vikṣipann iva prabhāṁ raver muniś cacāla kṣayakāladāruṇaḥ kṣitiṁ saśailāṁ calayann |

sa pradhvanayyāmbudanādi cāpaṁ hastena diṅnāga balāni śambhor iṣubhis tatāpa cetāṁsi cintābhir ivāśarīraḥ ||
sadvāditevābhiniviṣṭabuddhau guṇābhyasūyeva agocare vāg iva copareme śaktiḥ śarāṇāṁ śitikaṇṭhakāye ||
umāpatiṁ pāṇḍusutapraṇunnāḥ śilīmukhā na abhyutthitasyādripater nitambam arkasya pādā iva |
saṁprīyamāṇo .nubabhūva tīvraṁ parākramaṁ tasya patir viṣāṇabhedaṁ himavān asahyaṁ vaprānatasyeva |
tasmai hi bhāroddharaṇe samarthaṁ pradāsyatā bāhum iva ciraṁ viṣehe .bhibhavas tadānīṁ sa kāraṇānām api |
pratyāhataujāḥ kṛtasattvavegaḥ parākramaṁ jyāyasi yas tejāṁsi bhānor iva niṣpatanti yaśāṁsi vīryajvalitāni tasya ||
dṛṣṭāvadānād vyathate .rilokaḥ pradhvaṁsam eti vyathitāc tejovihīnaṁ vijahāti darpaḥ śāntārciṣaṁ dīpam iva |
tataḥ prayātyastamadāvalepaḥ sa jayyatāyāḥ padavīṁ gandhena jetuḥ pramukhāgatasya pratidvipasyeva |
evaṁ pratidvandviṣu tasya kīrtiṁ maulīndulekhāviśadāṁ iyeṣa paryāyajayāvasādāṁ raṇakriyāṁ śambhur |
muner vicitrair iṣubhiḥ sa bhūyān ninye vaśaṁ bhūtapater sahātmalābhena samutpatadbhir jātisvabhāvair iva |
vitanvatas tasya śarāndhakāraṁ trastāni sainyāni ravaṁ pravarṣataḥ saṁtatavepathūni kṣapāghanasyeva gavāṁ |
sa sāyakān sādhvasaviplutānāṁ kṣipan pareṣām śaśīva doṣāvṛtalocanānāṁ vibhidyamānaḥ pṛthag ābabhāse |
kṣobheṇa tenātha gaṇādhipānāṁ bhedaṁ yayāv ākṛtir taraṅgakampena mahāhradānāṁ chāyāmayasyeva dinasya |
prasedivāṁsaṁ na tam āpa kopaḥ kutaḥ parasmin puruṣe ākāravaiṣamyam idaṁ ca bheje durlakṣyacihnā mahatāṁ hi |
visphāryamāṇasya tato bhujābhyāṁ bhūtāni bhartrā dhanur bhinnākṛtiṁ jyāṁ dadṛśuḥ sphurantīṁ kruddhasya jihvām |
savyāpasavyadhvanitogracāpaṁ pārthaḥ kirātādhipam paryāyasampāditakarṇatālaṁ yantā gajaṁ vyālam |
nijaghnire tasya hareṣujālaiḥ patanti vṛndāni śilīmukhānām ūrjasvibhiḥ sindhumukhāgatāni yādāṁsi yādobhir |
vibhedam antaḥ padavīnirodhaṁ vidhvaṁsanaṁ netārilokeṣu karoti yad yat tat tac cakārāsya śareṣu |
soḍhāvagītaprathamāyudhasya krodhojhitair vegitayā chinnair api trāsitavāhinīkaiḥ pete kṛtārthair iva tasya |
bāṇacchidas te viśikhāḥ smarārer avāṅmukhībhūtaphalāḥ akhaṇḍitaṁ pāṇḍavasāyakebhyaḥ kṛtasya sadyaḥ |
citrīyamāṇān atilāghavena pramāthinas tān samākulāyā nicakhāna dūraṁ bāṇān dhvajinyā hṛdayeṣv |
anāmṛśantaḥ kvacid eva marma priyaiṣiṇānuprahitāḥ suhṛtprayuktā iva narmavādāḥ śarā muneḥ prītikarā |
astraiḥ samānām atirekiṇīṁ vā paśyanīṣūṇām api tasya viṣādavaktavyabalaḥ pramāthī svam ālalambe balam |
tapas tapovīryasamuddhatasya pāraṁ yiyāsoḥ maheṣujālāny akhilāni jiṣṇor arkaḥ payāṁsīva samācacāma |
rikte savisrambham athcharjunasya niṣaṅgavaktre nipatāta anyadvipāpītajale satarṣaṁ mataṅgajasyeva |
cyute sa tasminn iṣudhau śarārthād dhvastārthasāre tatkālamoghapraṇayaḥ prapede nirvācyatākāma |
āghaṭṭayāmāsa gatāgatābhyāṁ sāvegam agrāṅgulir asya vidheyamārge matir utsukasya nayaprayogāv iva gāṁ |
babhāra śūnyākṛtir arjunas tau maheṣudhī vītamaheṣujālau yugāntasaṁśuṣkajalau vijihmaḥ pūrvāparau loka |
pratikriyāyai vidhuraḥ sa tasmāt kṛcchreṇa viśleṣam iyāya parāṅmukhatve .pi kṛtopakārāt tūṇīmukhān mitrakulād |
paścātkriyā tūṇayugasya bhartur jajñe tadānīm upakāriṇīva sambhāvanāyām adharīkṛtāyāṁ patyuḥ puraḥ sāhasam |
taṁ śambhur ākṣiptamaheṣujālaṁ lohaiḥ śarair marmasu hṛttottaraṁ tattvavicāramadhye vakteva doṣair gurubhir |
jahāra cāsmād acireṇa varma caṇḍaḥ pataṅgān marudekanīlaṁ taḍitvataḥ khaṇḍam |
vikośanirdhautatanor mahāseḥ phaṇāvataś ca tvaci pratidvipābaddharuṣaḥ samakṣaṁ nāgasya |
vibodhitasya dhvaninā ghanānāṁ harer apetasya ca nirastadhūmasya ca rātrivahner vinā tanutreṇa ruciṁ sa |
acittatāyām api nāma yuktām anūrdhvatāṁ prāpya mahīṁ gatau tāv iṣudhī tadānīṁ vivavratuś cetanayeva |
sthitaṁ viśuddhe nabhasīva sattve dhāmnā śastrābhighātais tam ajasram īśas tvaṣṭā vivasvantam |
saṁrambhavegojjhitavedaneṣu gātreṣu bādhiryam muner babhūvāgaṇiteṣurāśer lauhas tiraskāra |
tato .nupūrvāyatavṛttabāhuḥ śrīmān āskandya vegena vimuktanādaḥ kṣitiṁ vidhunvann iva |
sāmyaṁ gatenāśaninā maghonaḥ śambhuṁ bibhitsur dhanuṣā jaghāna stambaṁ viṣāṇena |
rayeṇa sā saṁnidadhe patantī bhavodbhavenātmani samuddhatā sindhur anekamārgā pare sthitenaujasi |
vikārmukaḥ karmasu śocanīyaḥ paricyutaudārya vicikṣipe śūlabhṛtā salīlaṁ sa patribhir dūram adūrapātaiḥ |
upoḍhakalyāṇaphalo .bhirakṣan vīravrataṁ japopavāsair iva saṁyatātmā tepe munis tair iṣubhiḥ |
tato .grabhūmiṁ vyavasāyasiddheḥ sīmānam anyair tejaḥśriyām āśrayam uttamāsiṁ sākṣād ahaṁkāram |
śarān avadyann anavadyakarmā cacāra citraṁ hastena nistriṁśabhṛtā sa dīptaḥ sārkāṁśunā vāridhir |
yathā nije vartmani bhāti bhābhiś cyāyāmayaś cāpsu tathā nabhasy āśu raṇasthalīṣu spaṣṭadvimūrtir dadṛśe sa |
śivapraṇunnena śilīmukhena tsarupradeśād apavarjitāṅgaḥ jvalann asis tasya papāta pāṇer ghanasya vaprād iva |
ākṣiptacāpāvaraṇeṣujālaś chinnottamāsiḥ sa mṛdhe riktaḥ prakāśaś ca babhūva bhūmer utsāditodyāna iva |
sa khaṇḍanaṁ prāpya parād amarṣavān bhujadvitīyo .pi sasarja vṛṣṭiṁ parirugṇapādapāṁ dravetareṣāṁ payasām |
nīrandhraṁ parigamite kṣayaṁ pṛṣatkair bhūtānām ucchrāyasthagitanabhodigantarālaṁ cikṣepa kṣitiruhajālam |
niḥśeṣaṁ śakalitavalkalāṅgasāraiḥ kurvadbhir bhuvam īśānaḥ sakusumapallavair nagais tair ātene balim iva |
unmajjan makara ivāmārāpagāyā vegena pratimukham gāṇḍīvī kanakaśilānibhaṁ bhujābhyām ājaghne viṣam |
abhilaṣata upāyaṁ vikramaṁ kīrtilakṣmyor asugamam janaka iva śiśutve supriyasyaikasūnor avinayam api sehe |
tata udagra iva dvirade munau raṇam upeyuṣi dhanur apāsya sabāṇadhi śaṁkaraḥ pratijaghāna ghanair |
harapṛthāsutayor dhvanir utpatann sphuṭadanalpaśilāravadāruṇaḥ pratinanāda darīṣu |
śivabhujāhatibhinnapṛthukṣatīḥ sukham ivānubabhūva ka iva nāma bṛhanmanasāṁ bhaved anukṛter api |
vraṇamukhacyutaśoṇitaśīkarasthagitaśailataṭābhabhujāntarabhinavauṣasarāgabhṛtā babhau jaladhareṇa samānam |
urasi śūlabhṛtaḥ prahitā muhuḥ pratihatiṁ yayur bhṛśarayā iva sahyamahībhṛtaḥ pṛthuni rodhasi |
nipatite .dhiśirodharam āyate samam aratniyuge tricatureṣu padeṣu kirīṭinā lulitadṛṣṭi madād iva caskhale ||
abhibhavoditamanyuvidīpitaḥ samabhisṛtya bhṛśaṁ javam bhujayugena vibhajya samādade śaśikalābharaṇasya |
pravavṛte .tha mahāhavamallayor acalasaṁcalanāharaṇo karaṇaśṛṅkhalasaṁkalanāgurur gurubhujāyudhagarvitayos |
ayam asau bhagavān uta pāṇḍavaḥ sthitam avāṅ muninā samadhirūḍham ajena nu jiṣṇunā svid iti vegavaśān |
pracalite calitaṁ sthitam āsthite vinamite natam unnatam vṛṣakapidhvajayor asahiṣṇunā muhur abhāvabhayād iva |
karaṇaśṛṅkhalaniḥsṛtayos tayoḥ kṛtabhujadhvani valgu caraṇapātanipātitarodharasaḥ prasasṛpuḥ saritaḥ paritaḥ |
viyati vegapariplutam antarā samabhisṛtya rayeṇa caraṇayoś caraṇānamitakṣitir nijagṛhe tisṛṇāṁ jayinaṁ |
vismitaḥ sapadi tena karmaṇā karmaṇāṁ kṣayakaraḥ paraḥ kṣeptukāmam avanau tam aklamaṁ niṣpipeṣa parirabhya |
tapasā tathā na mudam asya yayau bhagavān yathā guṇasaṁhateḥ samatiriktam aho nijam eva sattvam upakāri |
atha himaśucibhasmabhūṣitaṁ śirasi virājitam indulekhayā svavapur atimanoharaṁ haraṁ dadhatam udīkṣya nanāma |
sahaśaradhi nijaṁ tathā kārmukaṁ vapur atanu tathaiva nihitam api tathaiva paśyann asiṁ vṛṣabhagatir upāyayau |
siṣicur avanim ambuvāhāḥ śanaiḥ surakusumam iyāya vimalaruci bhṛśaṁ nabho dundubher dhvanir akhilam |
āseduṣāṁ gotrabhido .nuvṛttyā gopāyakānāṁ rociṣṇuratnāvalibhir vimānair dyaur ācitā tārakiteva reje ||
haṁsā bṛhantaḥ surasadmavāhāḥ saṁhrādikaṇṭhābharaṇāḥ cakruḥ prayatnena vikīryamāṇair vyomnaḥ pariṣvaṅgam |
kṛtadhṛti parivanditenoccakair gaṇapatibhir tapasi kṛtaphale phalajyāyasī stutir iti jagade hareḥ sūnunā |
śaraṇaṁ bhavantam atikāruṇikaṁ bhava bhaktigamyam jitamṛtyavo .jita bhavanti bhaye sasurāsurasya jagataḥ |
vipad eti tāvad avasādakarī na ca kāmasampad na namanti caikapuruṣaṁ puruṣās tava yāvad īśa na natiḥ |
saṁsevante dānaśīlā vimuktya sampaśyanto yanniḥsaṅgas tvaṁ phalasyānatebhyas tat kāruṇyaṁ |
prāpyate yad iha dūram agatvā yat phalaty tīrtham asti na bhavārṇavabāhyaṁ sārvakāmikam ṛte |
vrajati śuci padaṁ tv ati prītimān pratihatamatir eti ghorāṁ iyam anagha nimittaśaktiḥ parā tava varada na cittabhedaḥ |
dakṣiṇāṁ praṇatadakṣiṇa mūrtiṁ tattvataḥ śivakarīm rāgiṇāpi vihitā tava bhaktyā saṁsmṛtir bhava bhavaty |
dṛṣṭvā dṛśyāny ācaraṇīyāni vidhāya prekṣākārī yāti padaṁ samyagdṛṣṭis tasya paraṁ paśyati yas tvāṁ yaś copāsti |
yuktāḥ svaśaktyā munayaḥ prajānāṁ hitopadeśair samucchinatsi tvam acintyadhāmā karmāṇy upetasya |
saṁnibaddham apahartum ahāryaṁ bhūri durgatibhayaṁ adbhutākṛtim imām atimāyas tvaṁ bibharṣi karuṇāmaya |
na rāgi cetaḥ paramā vilāsitā vadhūḥ śarīre .sti na cāsti namaskriyā coṣasi dātur ity aho nisargadurbodham idaṁ |
tavottarīyaṁ karicarma sāṅgajaṁ jvalanmaṇiḥ sāraśanaṁ srag āsyapaṅktiḥ śavabhasma candanaṁ kalā himāṁśoś ca |
avigrahasyāpy atulena hetunā sametabhinnadvayamūrti tavaiva nānyasya jagatsu dṛśyate viruddhaveṣābharaṇasya |
ātmalābhapariṇāmanirodhair bhūtasaṁgha iva na tvam tena sarvabhuvanātiga loke nopamānam asi nāpy |
tvam antakaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṁ tvayā jagat prāṇiti deva tvaṁ yogināṁ hetuphale ruṇatsi tvaṁ kāraṇaṁ |
rakṣobhiḥ suramanujair diteḥ sutair vā yal lokeṣv avikalam pāvinyāḥ śaraṇagatārtihāriṇe tan māhātmyaṁ bhava |
tarasā bhuvanāni yo bibharti dhvanati brahma yataḥ paraṁ parito duritāni yaḥ punīte śiva tasmai pavanātane namas te |
bhavataḥ smaratāṁ sadāsane jayini brahmamaye dahate bhavabījasaṁtatiṁ śikhine .nekaśikhāya te namaḥ ||
ābādhāmaraṇabhayārciṣā cirāya pluṣṭebhyo bhava mahatā nirvāṇaṁ samupagamena yacchate te bījānāṁ prabhava |
yaḥ sarveṣām āvarītā varīyān sarvair bhāvair nāvṛto mārgātītāyendriyāṇāṁ namas te .vijñeyāya vyomarūpāya |
aṇīyase viśvavidhāriṇe namo namo .ntikasthāya namo atītya vācāṁ manasāṁ ca gocaraṁ sthitāya te tatpataye |
asaṁvidānasya mameśa saṁvidāṁ titikṣituṁ duścaritaṁ virodhya mohāt punar abhyupeyuṣāṁ gatir bhavān eva |
āstikyaśuddham avataḥ priyadharma dharmaṁ samprāpnuyāṁ vijayam īśa yayā samṛddhyā tāṁ |
iti nigaditavantaṁ sūnum uccair maghonaḥ praṇataśirasam jvaladanalaparītaṁ raudram astraṁ dadhānaṁ |
sa piṅgākṣaḥ śrīmān bhuvanamahanīyena mahasā tanuṁ parītyeśānaṁ triḥ stutibhir upagītaḥ suragaṇaiḥ sutaṁ |
atha śaśadharamauler abhyanujñām avāpya avitathaphalam āśirvādam āropayanto vijayi vividham |
asaṁhāryotsāhaṁ jayinam udayaṁ prāpya tarasā dhuraṁ svadhāmnā lokānāṁ tam upari kṛtasthānam amarās |
vraja jaya ripulokaṁ pādapadmānataḥ san gadita iti śivena nijagṛham atha gatvā sādaraṁ pāṇḍuputro |
